name: a2a reference design parameters
notes: All parameter values are design choices of this pack, not measured live-platform values.
The 'issuer' in the lab drill is a fresh LAB keypair; no live issuer key is known or used.
verification_order: 1. action well-formed and payload within size cap
2. timestamp within clock-skew window and action TTL
4. capability token: trusted issuer, task match, validity window
6. capability required by the action is contained in the token
7. signature verifies against the claimed agent key
8. payload hash matches the signed hash
